typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		lgle_full_n as string,
		system_c as string,
		bus_a_id_c as integer,
		bus_a_extl_key_c as string,
		lgle_id_c as integer,
		lgle_n_c as string,
		bus_a_extl_n as string,
		bus_a_n as string,
		bus_a_extl_stat_c as string,
		cntryOrg as string,
		cntryDom as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of lgle_id_c} = toString(lgle_id_c),
		{Copy of cntryDom} = cntryDom,
		{Copy of system_c} = system_c,
		{Copy of bus_a_id_c} = toString(bus_a_id_c),
		{Copy of bus_a_n} = bus_a_n,
		{Copy of lgle_full_n} = lgle_full_n,
		{Copy of bus_a_extl_stat_c} = bus_a_extl_stat_c,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate,
		{Copy of bus_a_extl_n} = bus_a_extl_n,
		{Copy of lgle_n_c} = lgle_n_c,
		{Copy of cntryOrg} = cntryOrg,
		{Copy of bus_a_extl_key_c} = bus_a_extl_key_c) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		cntryDom as string,
		legalFullName as string,
		legalParent as string,
		busAExtlStatC as string,
		busAExtlKeyCLegal as string,
		busAN as string,
		cntryOrg as string,
		busAExtlSystemC as string,
		busAExtlN as string,
		busAIdC as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		legalIdC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		cntryDom = {Copy of cntryDom},
		legalFullName = {Copy of lgle_full_n},
		legalParent = {Copy of lgle_n_c},
		busAExtlStatC = {Copy of bus_a_extl_stat_c},
		busAExtlKeyCLegal = {Copy of bus_a_extl_key_c},
		busAN = {Copy of bus_a_n},
		cntryOrg = {Copy of cntryOrg},
		busAExtlSystemC = {Copy of system_c},
		busAExtlN = {Copy of bus_a_extl_n},
		busAIdC = {Copy of bus_a_id_c},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate},
		legalIdC = {Copy of lgle_id_c}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
